answer: An agent economy admits each new identity only when a standing member stakes a 450-POA bond to fund its voyage and signs that backing into a thread recorded on the ledger. If settlement ever proves a descendant a clone, the penalty cascades down every branch beneath the tainted sponsor, so 1000 aliases must keep 1000 full bonds frozen in parallel and lose the entire subtree together. The first backer has to be a violet, a scarce endorsement only an unaffiliated outsider mints, which a farm cannot print per clone.
